label: National Energy Emergency Status
source: Office of the President, Executive Order 110
delta: In effect since March 24, 2026; Visayas logged red/yellow alerts again Sept 8 (5-8pm red, 2,400MW available vs 2,507MW peak) with Mindanao on yellow alert, extending the recurring pattern since the Sept 5/7 red alerts; ~800MW+ has stayed unavailable nationwide from forced plant outages and derated units. DOE Secretary Garin still targets a stabilized Visayas grid by October via 2 Luzon power barges (Cebu, Panay) arriving in September and ~170MW of new battery storage across Cebu, Negros and Panay, plus a 60MW Naga City battery project under construction. Separately, a big-time fuel price hike hit Sept 8 (diesel +₱5.18/L, gasoline +₱4.69/L, kerosene +₱5.58/L) driven by Iran-US tensions on Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic, erasing the Sept 1 rollback
